## Carousel

- Changing game now works like the Apple TV app: the logo, stats and buttons fade out, the picture drifts slightly sideways as the next game dissolves in, and then its logo and buttons fade back in. The same change is used when a trailer ends, when you swipe, tap the dots or use the controller.
- Swiping moves the picture just a little under your finger; past the first or last game it wraps round.
